laravel.runtime: Laravel scoped background-owner context carrying only the owning user primary key with nested idempotent leases and scope-reset isolation

acceptance.owner_only_identity: The ambient value contains only the owning Laravel user primary key and never authenticates the owner or carries roles, permissions or administrator state.
acceptance.nested_restore: Nested pushes restore the immediately previous owner when their leases are disposed.
acceptance.idempotent_dispose: Repeated lease disposal is a no-op after the first restore.
acceptance.fail_closed_identity: Zero and negative owner identifiers are rejected without mutating the active owner.
acceptance.tenant_scope_isolation: A Laravel scoped-instance reset between tenant queue-job scopes yields a fresh background identity so Tenant A ownership cannot leak into Tenant B.
acceptance.worker_lifecycle: The service is registered with Laravel scoped lifetime, matching queue-worker job/request scope boundaries rather than process-global mutable identity.
acceptance.exception_safety: The lease destructor is a fail-safe restoration path while explicit dispose remains the deterministic canonical contract.
